svg.title: Mapped uses in the generative language model display group
svg.desc: Enlarged excerpt of all 17 columns in the map’s generative language model display group across eight review stages. Neutral outlines identify its four red synthesis cells without changing their colours or recommendations. Individual product implementations and the map’s category qualifications remain governed by the interactive map.
